column3: OWNER BUG REPORT (top priority, 2026-11-07): driving the player's car "doesn't accelerate properly and doesn't let me turn right". Reproduce it with a headless probe that puts the player in a parked car (sedan, crossover, pickup, sports, a motorcycle, a lowrider) on a flat street and drives it with simulated Input actions: measure 0-60 time, top speed, yaw rate with move_left vs move_right at 5/15/30 m/s. Find the ROOT cause (vehicle.gd _physics_process input/steer, _fly(), DriveCam, ChaseFlatTyres, Lowrider hydraulics drive_input, CrashDeform knocked wheels, TrafficMotion, any other system writing steering / engine_force / brake / wheel friction on the player's car, input actions shared with D / right stick / gamepad, the steer_min_factor curve, engine_power vs mass). Fix it at source, keep the fix small in vehicle.gd. Add tests/drive_fix_checks.gd that FAILS on today's main (left and right yaw rates must match within 10 %, the car must reach 100 km/h in a sane time). Push the fix EARLY (first working commit within 2 hours): the other driving sessions build on it. You own the core of Vehicle._physics_process; tell the others nothing, the lead merges.

Driving feel, ACCELERATION: the player's car should pull like a 2026 open-world game (GTA 6 style arcade-realism, a little exaggerated: this is an overpowered chaos game). Build a torque curve + gearbox model for the PLAYER-DRIVEN car (a new DriveTrain class, scripts/vehicles/drive_train.gd, one hook in Vehicle; per BodyType numbers from mass and class: sports fast, van slow, trucks heavy) that EngineAudio's step_engine() revs agree with (read engine_audio.gd: share the gear / rpm state, don't fight it). Launch, mid-range pull, top speed per class, engine braking, reverse. A probe that prints 0-100 km/h and top speed per body type, before and after. DRIVETRAIN=0 the A/B. Branch from main; if wt/drive-fix has pushed, merge it in. Do not touch steering or tyres (other sessions).

Driving feel, STEERING AND GRIP: make cornering feel great and symmetric for the player's car - speed-sensitive steering that is quick at low speed and stable at high speed, a tyre model on VehicleWheel3D friction_slip / per-wheel grip with a front/rear balance that gives mild understeer at the limit, steering return-to-centre, counter-steer assist when the rear slides, smooth keyboard steering ramps (keyboard is digital: ease in/out) and analog stick curves. New class scripts/vehicles/drive_handling.gd, one hook in Vehicle. Probe: yaw rate and lateral g left vs right at several speeds, slalom, a 90-degree junction turn at 40 km/h. DRIVE_HANDLING=0 the A/B. Branch from main; merge wt/drive-fix when it has pushed. Do not touch engine/gearbox (drive-engine) or drift (drive-drift).

Driving feel, HANDBRAKE AND DRIFT: the handbrake (right click / pad) should swing the rear out into a controllable arcade drift you can hold with throttle and counter-steer, then grip back up; power-oversteer on RWD sports cars; J-turns and 180s possible. Hook DrivingFX's smoke and skid marks so they follow the slide (read scripts/vehicles/driving_fx.gd). New class scripts/vehicles/drive_drift.gd, one hook in Vehicle. Probe and strips of a drift. DRIVE_DRIFT=0 the A/B. Branch from main; merge wt/drive-fix when it has pushed. Coordinate by staying out of drive_handling.gd / drive_train.gd.

Driving feel, SUSPENSION AND WEIGHT: the player's car should visibly and physically pitch under braking/acceleration, roll in corners, settle over bumps and kerbs, land jumps without bouncing forever, and not snag on kerbs (a kerb at an angle should bump, not stop the car dead). Tune per-body suspension stiffness/damping/travel and centre of mass (low enough that it never flips in a normal corner, high enough to roll), anti-roll in code. New class scripts/vehicles/drive_suspension.gd, one hook in Vehicle. Probes: kerb strike at 30 km/h and 20 degrees, a 1 m drop, a hard stop from 100 km/h, a lane change at 80. DRIVE_SUSPENSION=0 the A/B. Branch from main; merge wt/drive-fix when it has pushed.

Driving feel, IMPACTS AND TRAFFIC: hitting kinematic traffic cars, parked cars, props and walls should feel weighty and fun, not like hitting concrete or a ghost - momentum transfer to the traffic car (it goes physical and gets shoved), the player keeps sensible speed through light props (PropBreak smash_ahead exists), glancing wall hits scrape and redirect instead of stopping dead, no getting stuck in kerbs/poles/medians, an unstick nudge when wedged. New class scripts/vehicles/drive_impacts.gd, one hook. Probes: 50 km/h into a traffic car, a glancing 30-degree wall hit, a lamp post at 80. DRIVE_IMPACTS=0 the A/B. Branch from main; merge wt/drive-fix when it has pushed.

Driving CONTROLS AND FEEL OF INPUT: audit every input path for the player's car on keyboard, mouse and gamepad (project.godot actions, Input.get_vector deadzones, triggers as analog throttle/brake on a pad, brake-then-reverse logic, the handbrake on right click vs alt_fire aim conflicts while driving, gear letter in VehicleHud, camera/look-behind in DriveCam). Make analog triggers proportional, add a brake-to-reverse delay that feels right, make sure no other action eats WASD or the right stick while driving, and expose the main feel knobs in GameSettings (steering sensitivity, auto-centre). Also check motorcycles' and boats' input paths for the same bugs. Small changes in vehicle.gd input lines only; new code in scripts/vehicles/drive_input.gd. DRIVE_INPUT=0 the A/B. Branch from main; merge wt/drive-fix when it has pushed.

Driving ASSISTS AND AI-CAR PARITY: (1) a light stability/traction-control assist for the player (keeps a car from spinning on throttle mid-corner unless the handbrake or drift is in use), ABS-like braking that still steers; (2) make traffic cars that go physical (after a hit, CarPanic, police PURSUE in police_car.gd, EmergencyCar back to lanes) use sane steering and throttle so they do not spin or stall - review PoliceCar._pursue / _path_target for the same steering sign and acceleration bugs the owner reported on the player's car. New class scripts/vehicles/drive_assist.gd. DRIVE_ASSIST=0 the A/B. Branch from main; merge wt/drive-fix when it has pushed.
